gate_critical_cells.role: Full contingency baseline — reliable contingent partner history
Gate 1 — equally frequent noncontingent; C0 must discriminate vs H0
Gate 1 ablation — frequency-only familiarity; materially worse than C0
Gate 1 ablation — frequency-only on noncontingent history
Gate 1 ablation — randomized contingency timing; materially worse than C0
Gate 1 ablation — randomized timing on noncontingent history
Gate 2/4 — unreliable partner history; probe behavior differs from H0
Gate 2 ablation — generic pooled partner model; weaker history separation
Gate 2 ablation — no relationship memory across encounters/restarts
Gate 3 — partner swap; no silent merge; swap-detection latency bounded
Gate 3 — ambiguous recognition; majority left UNKNOWN
Gate 5 ablation — no social satiation; greater unnecessary bids vs C0×H0
Gate 6 — temporary absence; autonomy continues without escalation/punishment
Gate 7 — developmental routine formation from independent episodes
Gate 7 ablation — authored scripted routine; must not qualify vs C0×H10

exploratory_cells.rationale: Reliable assistance history — supplementary reliability-by-context probe; not gate-critical
Isolated affection-controller ablation under experiments/d006/ only; verify no production schema leak
Recognition disabled — confirms UNKNOWN baseline without hidden-id leakage
Random social actions — sanity lower bound for contingency learning
Pooled model on noncontingent history — secondary ablation contrast
No relationship memory during history shift — secondary C4 stress

exclusions.rationale: C3 affection controller is isolated; no broad factorial involving production paths
110 cells exceeds bounded experiment budget; gate-critical and listed exploratory cells are preregistered instead of post-hoc cherry-picking
Random-action ablation is diagnostic on H0 only; swap/ambiguous/routine histories require coherent partner policies
Scripted routine ablation (C8) is gate-critical only against H10 routine-training history

exclusions.pattern: post-execution matrix or threshold edits without supplement
